parameters.name: --profile
parameters.description: Credential profile stored on the probe.

parameters.name: --anonymous-identity
parameters.description: The outer identity for the tunnel.

parameters.name: --ca-cert
parameters.description: CA certificate file that signed the RADIUS server.

parameters.name: --domain-suffix-match
parameters.description: Required suffix of the RADIUS server certificate.

parameters.name: --no-verify-server
parameters.description: Skip the RADIUS server certificate check.

parameters.name: --bssid
parameters.description: Restrict the test to one access point.

parameters.name: --stage
parameters.description: Stop after authentication or after DHCP.

parameters.name: --timeout
parameters.description: The time budget for the whole test in seconds.

parameters.name: --self-check
parameters.description: Only verify that the privileged helper is reachable.

settings.name: SSID
settings.description: The network this variant signs in to.

settings.name: AUTH
settings.description: The authentication method. It decides which of the fields below are needed.

settings.name: IDENTITY
settings.description: The enterprise user name, for PEAP.

settings.name: ANONYMOUS_IDENTITY
settings.description: The outer identity for the tunnel, if the RADIUS server expects one.

settings.name: DOMAIN_SUFFIX_MATCH
settings.description: Required suffix of the RADIUS server certificate.

settings.name: BSSID
settings.description: Restrict this variant to one access point.

credentials.name: PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWD
credentials.description: Passphrase of the private key, if it carries one.

files.name: CA_CERT
files.description: The authority that signed the RADIUS server certificate. Without it the server is not verified.

files.name: CLIENT_CERT
files.description: The probe's own certificate, for AUTH=eap-tls.

files.name: PRIVATE_KEY
files.description: The private key belonging to the client certificate.
